name: Nurse Aide I training and clinical requirements
authority: CMS (42 CFR §483.152) · NC DHSR Nurse Aide I curriculum · NNAAP / NC Nurse Aide Registry
edition: Federal minimums under 42 CFR 483.152 and the NC DHSR-approved NA I curriculum — starter content: verify hours against the current state curriculum
summary: A nurse aide training program must provide at least 75 clock hours, including at least 16 hours of supervised practical (clinical / laboratory) training, and the first 16 hours of instruction (communication, infection control, safety, residents' rights, independence) must come before any direct contact with a resident. Clinical training happens in a licensed long-term care facility (or hospital unit) under an RN instructor with a bounded student-to-instructor ratio; the state competency evaluation then covers the written test and the skills demonstration. Sites are limited by the supervising RN's ratio and the unit's resident census.
